verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a public API surface across multiple axes: a Metrics API v2 for aggregate queries, Python/JS SDKs for querying data, a CLI for terminal/agent use, an MCP server for tool-less AI agents, OTLP trace ingestion endpoint, and blob storage export — all documented under the API-and-data-platform docs. Community evidence (comm-8) confirms the trace/generation retrieval API is real and used in practice (albeit with performance caveats for bulk operations), corroborating that the API is functional, not just marketing copy.  Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s at candidate paths) and independent hands-on validation of API completeness beyond one user's bulk-query complaint.
